text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Danish telecommunications company TeleDanmark (TDK) wants to acquire a small stake in Portugal Telecom, Mette Therkildsen, director of the firm's Portuguese unit, told the paper.
- Businessman Antonio Champalimaud is studying the best way to reorganise his banks and insurance company Mundial Confianca, the paper said.
- Shares in mobile phone operator Telecel were up 24 pct on their first day of trading on the Lisbon stock exchange.
- Banco Portugues do Atlantico's (BPA) reorganization involved the placement of some 420 workers in new projects while around 1,000 received early retirement or were sacked.
- Under Secretary for Finance, Fernando Teixeira dos Santos, said in a debate that the political priority of joining the single currency still implied sacrifices.
- After the Nobel Peace Price ceremony the international community cannot ignore the call for peace in East Timor.
- Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) has spent 200 billion escudos so far on its acquisition of Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE).
